t: US will seek to contain India as it grows stronger — Russian ambassador
d: Denis Alipov clarified that earlier this year, at the Raisina Dialogue, a senior US official publicly said that the US would never allow India to become the next China

t: Russia open to practical proposals from India on Ukraine conflict — ambassador
d: Denis Alipov recalled that for decades, right up until 2022, Russia had done everything possible to persuade NATO to sit down at the negotiating table and agree on common principles of security in Europe

t: Russia ready to supply India with as much oil as it needs — ambassador
d: Denis Alipov added that in addition to oil, Russia has been India’s partner for many years in nuclear energy, petrochemical production, and oil refining
